verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an llms.txt at developer.konghq.com (HTTP 200), the documentation host for Insomnia. The Insomnia docs are also served as per-page markdown (e.g. /insomnia/test.md, /insomnia/scripts.md), which agents can consume directly. Missing for 10: the llms.txt is Kong-wide and the excerpt does not show Insomnia-specific entries, the /insomnia/.md index probe returned 404, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
